The Deception Of The Khawarij | Brother Shamsi 

The Muslim Brotherhood (Al-Ikhwān Al-Muslimūn), founded in Egypt circa 1928 CE by Hasan Al-Banna (died 1949 CE), established for themselves a principle that was intended to unite the Muslims through mutual cooperation, agreement and overlooking differences for the sake of reaching a “greater goal”, which was political power for the Ikhwān (Brotherhood) in Egypt and then the rest of the Middle-East, North Africa and elsewhere. By enacting this principle, the Muslim masses would be united under one banner and then mobilized to act against oppression and injustice. This principle of Al-Ikhwān Al-Muslimūn established by their founder, Hasan Al-Banna reads as:

نتعاون‭ ‬فيما‭ ‬اتفقنا‭ ‬عليه،‭ ‬ويعذر‭ ‬بعضنا‭ ‬بعضا‭ ‬فيما‭ ‬اختلفنا‭ ‬فيه

“We cooperate with one another in that which we agree upon — and we excuse [and overlook] one another in that which we differ.”

This principle has been adopted by a large body of proselytizers (du’āt) among the Muslims who call to unity through ignoring differences and focusing on the “end goal” as they see it.

Over the decades, this principle has become deeply-rooted into the methodology of many who see themselves as Islamic preachers; to the extent that if a Muslim is seen to be criticizing the erroneous beliefs or practices of other Muslims, he is dealt with swiftly (and often harshly); he is accused of extremism, causing disunity and weakness in the Muslim Ummah due to him pointing out the faults of other Muslims.

Armé des lances, face à des soldats britanniques équipés d’armes à feu. Ils affrontèrent, dans l’obscurité de la nuit, un empire sûr de sa puissance mais pris de court par l'audace de ceux qu’il croyait soumettre.
Il tomba, non sous le feu ennemi, mais victime d’un tir ami (ultime ironie d’une guerre menée pour l’honneur et la terre).
Que son nom vive dans la mémoire des hommes libres.

Do you want another video explaining shirk in detail ?

Shirk in Islam refers to the act of associating partners with Allah in His divinity, attributes, or rights of worship, and it is considered the gravest sin a person can commit. It directly contradicts the core of tawḥīd (the belief in the absolute Oneness of Allah), which is the foundation of the Islamic faith. Major shirk (shirk al-akbar) includes worshiping idols, invoking saints or other beings instead of Allah, or believing that anything besides Allah has ultimate power or control. Minor shirk (shirk al-asghar) can be more subtle, such as performing good deeds to show off or swearing by something other than Allah. The Qur’an emphasizes that Allah may forgive all sins except dying in a state of shirk without repentance. Because of its seriousness, Muslims are encouraged to constantly renew their sincerity, seek forgiveness, and protect their belief in the pure Oneness of Allah.

H.E. Abdisalam Abdi Ali

Federal Republic of Somalia

Mogadishu, Somalia
October 1, 2025

I extend my warmest congratulations to the Government and people of the friendly People’s Republic of China on the 76th anniversary of the founding of the Republic. This commemoration honors China’s enduring achievements and steadfast progress over the past seven decades.

Somalia cherishes its long-standing friendship with China, anchored in mutual respect and shared aspirations, guided by a spirit of cooperation and understanding, reinforced by solidarity and partnership, and committed to promoting the common good of our two peoples.

As China celebrates this momentous day, Somalia looks forward to working closely with the Chinese Government to strengthen bilateral ties, develop partnerships, advance collaborative projects, and jointly promote peace, development, and shared prosperity between our two beloved countries.

Happy National Day to the People’s Republic of China!

BAAJINTA COLAADDA SAYLAC: Talo Iyo Tusmeyn.
———-   ————-      —————   ———  ——————
Ugu horreyn, colaadda hadda ka taagan magaalada Saylac waa halis weyn oo haddaan hadda la xakameyn ku fidi karta inta u dhaxaysa Saylac illaa xaafadda Balbala ee caasimadda dalka Jabuuti, waxaynna noqon kartaa aafo colaadeed oo toos u qaadda dariiqa Aasho-caddo, laanta morohda, Cabdiqaadir, iyo Jidhi. Waxaana suurtagal ah in ay xadka ka gudubto oo ay colaaddu ka ooganto aagga u dhaxeeya degmooyinka Ayshaca, Arraabi, iyo Dambal, aakhirkana ay afka saarto xaruntii Shinniile iyo magalaada Diridhabe.  

Sidoo kale, waxaa hubaal ah in ay saameyn taban iyo barakac colaadeed ku yeelan doonto Afdam, Maa’iso, Harmukaale, hadhagaalle, Caydoora, Erer, Biki, Dawalle, Cali Sabiixi, nagaadhka, iyo Buurta Siitti. Mar kale xabbadda Saylac ka dhacdaa waxa ay alalas colaadeed iyo aafo ummadeed gaadhsiin kartaa degmooyinka Lughaya, Gargaara, Garbadar, Baki, Gaarisa, Fardaha, Xeego, Darracaso, Boon, Gargoorray, Habaas, Xariirad, Xaliimaale, Qulujeed, Jirjir, Daarcadde, Layllakaal, Harawo, Dharwanaaje, Lafaciise, Xerogeel, Dhammal, Gogti iyo sheekh nabadgelyo. Tani macnaheedu waa in ay dhici karto colaad sokeeye oo keeni karta dhig-bax ku yimaadda Jabuuti, Borama iyo dalnimada Somaliland, sababta ugu weyni waa in khilaafku salka ku hayo ahaansho bulsheed, lahaansho dhuleed iyo weeleyn taariikheed oo dhiig iyo dhalasho salka ku haysa, taasi oo laga dheefi karo is xasuuq ummadeed, mooraduug dhaqan-dhaqaale iyo gobonimo burbur dhab ah.

Haddaba, xalku muxuu yahay?, xalku waa in xilligan la helo dhawr qodob oo laf-dhabar iyo lama huraan u ah ka baaqsashada colaad iyo aafo dagaal  oo maanta  ibo-furkeedu ka bilaabmo magaalada taariikhiga ah ee Saylac. Tusaale ahaan:

1. In la joojiyo bandhigga  buugga Xeer Ciise ee 11. 10. 2025 loo ballaysimay in fantasiyihiisa lagu qabto magaalada Saylac. Waana in Wasaaradda Arrimaha gudaha iyo amniga qaranku gudato waajibaadkan oo soo Saartaa wareegto lagu joojinayo qabsoomidda xafladdan. Waayo, buugga Xeer Ciise waxa uu si buuxda oo aan war-wareeg lahayn u sugayaa lahaanshaha reernimo ee dhulka gobolka Salel, taasina waxay meesha ka saaraysa wada lahaanshaha dhulka ee beelaha walaalaha ah ee Ciise Iyo Samaroon.

2. In labada reerba laga joojiyo keli sheegashada iyo isku koobidda lahaanshaha magaalada Saylac. Sidoo kale  waa in dawladdu soo saartaa amar adag oo lagu mamnuucaayo adeegsiga erayada xanafta leh ee uga sii dari kara xaaladda kacsan ee hadda ka taagan  magaalada taariikhiga ah ee Saylac.

3. In badhasaabka Gobolka Salal si deg-deg ah xilka looga qaado, la soo magacaabo guddoomiye gobol oo ka soo jeeddaa beesha Samaroon, gaar ahaan beesha Bahabar Celi. Tani oo keenaysa in la helo dheellitir awood wadaag oo gobolka Salal ah, waayo waa gaf in duqa magaalada iyo guddoomiyaha gobolku ay hal reer noqdaan. Sidoo kale, waa in gobolka Salel loo fahmaa gobol la wada degen yahay, meeshana laga saaraa aragtida Hargeysa taalla ee ah in gobolku yahay gobol Ciise gaar u leeyahay, oo aan cidi la wadaagin lahaanshihiisa daleed, islamarkaana waa in si deg-deg ah xubnaha golaha wasiirrada, iyo taliyeyaasha ciidamadu ay isku miisaamaan habsami wadaagga madaxda laamaha dawladda iyo talisyada ciidanka ee heer gobol, iyo heer degmo.

4. In hoggaaminta dhaqanka, haldoorka, waxgaradka aqoonyahanka iyo nin-garboodka labada reer ay bilaabaan wadahadal dhab ah oo ujeeddadiisu tahay in  la xalliyo khilaafka iyo muranka yaalliinka noqday ee ku aaddan lahaanshaha Saylac, iyo guud ahaan gobolka Salel.

5. In labada dhinacba dhex loo noqdo, shaqo adagna laga qabto dadka ka soo Jedda beesha dhexe ee lahaanshaha Saylac gaar uga dhigaya reer gaar ah. 

6. In dawladdu ogaal u noqoto saameynta taban ee ka dhalan karta colaad goortan laga alkumo Saylac, waayo gobolka Awdal waxa uu dhacaa dhul ku fiican xeeladda dagaallada oo haddana leh baad iyo biyo joogto ah, taasi oo ay ka faa’iideysan karaan awooddo ka baxsan xayndaabka Somaliland, waxaana adkaan doonta dhaqan-celinta dhallinyarada qalinka uga guurtay la qabatinka adeegsiga qoriga, iyo qarannimo dhacsiinta awoodaha ciidan ee falsafaddooda aragtiyeed lagu abuuray difaaca reernimada.

A new paper from Jordan Street and Ali Altiok tracks the evolution of this shift through speeches at the UN Security Council.  

At the heart of this new discussion paper is a critical question: has the UN’s counter-terrorism architecture grown in proportion to security threats, or has a process of threat inflation led to the exaggeration of the issue of terrorism to aid institutional growth?  

Our findings show that, at a broad level, the frequency of terror-related language in UN Security Council discourse does track with major global ‘terror’ attacks and incidents. This helps explain a mutually reinforcing dynamic between discourse and institutional development: new threats lead to new resolutions, which create new structures, which in turn generate more meetings, reports and – ultimately – more rhetoric. This institutional momentum often outlasts the crises that triggered it, embedding counter-terrorism more deeply into the UN’s architecture.

The analysis draws out five key insights: 

1️⃣ Rhetorical leadership has shifted between major powers: While the US led initial efforts, Russia and China now dominate the discourse. 
2️⃣ Discourse drove institutional expansion: Institutional growth followed rhetorical trends.
3️⃣ Counter-terrorism at the UN is a self-sustaining agenda: Counter-terrorism discourse has become routinised and institutionalised, even during periods when the overall trend of ‘terror’ attacks declined.
4️⃣ The UN had a role in the expansion of counter-terrorism architecture: The Secretariat and UN entities have made strategic choices that deepened engagement with counter-terrorism, reflecting institutional incentives.
5️⃣ Not all concepts endure: Terms like ‘radicalisation’ remain contested and have not gained the same institutional traction as ‘terror’ or ‘extremism’.

Ugu horreyn, colaadda hadda ka taagan magaalada Saylac waa halis weyn oo haddaan hadda la xakameyn ku fidi karta inta u dhaxaysa Saylac illaa xaafadda Balbala ee caasimadda dalka Jabuuti, waxaynna noqon kartaa aafo colaadeed oo toos u qaadda dariiqa Aasho-caddo, laanta morohda, Cabdiqaadir, iyo Jidhi. Waxaana suurtagal ah in ay xadka ka gudubto oo ay colaaddu ka ooganto aagga u dhaxeeya degmooyinka Ayshaca, Arraabi, iyo Dambal, aakhirkana ay afka saarto xaruntii Shinniile iyo magalaada Diridhabe.  

Sidoo kale, waxaa hubaal ah in ay saameyn taban iyo barakac colaadeed ku yeelan doonto Afdam, Maa’iso, Harmukaale, hadhagaalle, Caydoora, Erer, Biki, Dawalle, Cali Sabiixi, nagaadhka, iyo Buurta Siitti. Mar kale xabbadda Saylac ka dhacdaa waxa ay alalas colaadeed iyo aafo ummadeed gaadhsiin kartaa degmooyinka Lughaya, Gargaara, Garbadar, Baki, Gaarisa, Fardaha, Xeego, Darracaso, Boon, Gargoorray, Habaas, Xariirad, Xaliimaale, Qulujeed, Jirjir, Daarcadde, Layllakaal, Harawo, Dharwanaaje, Lafaciise, Xerogeel, Dhammal, Gogti iyo sheekh nabadgelyo. Tani macnaheedu waa in ay dhici karto colaad sokeeye oo keeni karta dhig-bax ku yimaadda Jabuuti, Borama iyo dalnimada Somaliland, sababta ugu weyni waa in khilaafku salka ku hayo ahaansho bulsheed, lahaansho dhuleed iyo weeleyn taariikheed oo dhiig iyo dhalasho salka ku haysa, taasi oo laga dheefi karo is xasuuq ummadeed, mooraduug dhaqan-dhaqaale iyo gobonimo burbur dhab ah.

Haddaba, xalku muxuu yahay?, xalku waa in xilligan la helo dhawr qodob oo laf-dhabar iyo lama huraan u ah ka baaqsashada colaad iyo aafo dagaal  oo maanta  ibo-furkeedu ka bilaabmo magaalada taariikhiga ah ee Saylac. Tusaale ahaan:

1. In la joojiyo ballaysinka bandhigga Xeer Ciise ee 11. 10. 2025, Waana in Wasaaradda Arrimaha gudaha iyo amniga qaranku gudato waajibaadkan oo soo Saartaa wareegto lagu joojinayo qabsoomidda xafladdan. Waayo, buugga Xeer Ciise waxa uu si buuxda oo aan war-wareeg lahayn u sugayaa lahaanshaha reernimo ee dhulka gobolka Salel, taasina waxay meesha ka saaraysa wada lahaanshaha dhulka ee beelaha walaalaha ah ee Ciise Iyo Samaroon.

2. In labada reerba laga joojiyo keli sheegashada iyo isku koobidda lahaanshaha magaalada Saylac. Sidoo kale  waa in dawladdu soo saartaa amar adag oo lagu mamnuucaayo adeegsiga erayada xanafta leh ee uga sii dari kara xaaladda kacsan ee hadda ka taagan  magaalada taariikhiga ah ee Saylac.

3. In badhasaabka Gobolka Salal si deg-deg ah xilka looga qaado, la soo magacaabo guddoomiye gobol oo ka soo jeeddaa beesha Samaroon, gaar ahaan beesha Bahabar Celi. Tani oo keenaysa in la helo dheellitir awood wadaag oo gobolka Salal ah, waayo waa gaf in duqa magaalada iyo guddoomiyaha gobolku ay hal reer noqdaan. Sidoo kale, waa in gobolka Salel loo fahmaa gobol la wada degen yahay, meeshana laga saaraa aragtida Hargeysa taalla ee ah in gobolku yahay gobol Ciise gaar u leeyahay, oo aan cidi la wadaagin lahaanshihiisa daleed, islamarkaana waa in si deg-deg ah xubnaha golaha wasiirrada, iyo taliyeyaasha ciidamadu ay isku miisaamaan habsami wadaagga madaxda laamaha dawladda iyo talisyada ciidanka ee heer gobol, iyo heer degmo.

5. In labada dhinacba dhex loo noqdo, shaqo adagna laga qabto dadka ka soo Jedda beesha dhexe ee lahaanshaha Saylac gaar uga dhigaya reer gaar ah. 

6. In dawladdu ogaal u noqoto saameynta taban ee ka dhalan karta colaad goortan laga alkumo Saylac, waayo gobolka Awdal waxa uu dhacaa dhul ku fiican xeeladda dagaallada oo haddana leh baad iyo biyo joogto ah, taasi oo ay ka faa’iideysan karaan awooddo ka baxsan xayndaabka Somaliland, waxaana adkaan doonta dhaqan-celinta dhallinyarada qalinka uga guurtay la qabatinka adeegsiga qoriga, iyo qarannimo dhacsiinta awoodaha ciidan ee falsafaddooda aragtiyeed lagu abuuray difaaca reernimada.

Over the past 25 years, counter-terrorism has transformed from a peripheral concern into a major institutional architecture of the United Nations (UN). But how did this happen?  

A new paper tracks the evolution of this shift through speeches at the UN Security Council.  

At the heart of this new discussion paper is a critical question: has the UN’s counter-terrorism architecture grown in proportion to security threats, or has a process of threat inflation led to the exaggeration of the issue of terrorism to aid institutional growth?  

Our findings show that, at a broad level, the frequency of terror-related language in UN Security Council discourse does track with major global ‘terror’ attacks and incidents. This helps explain a mutually reinforcing dynamic between discourse and institutional development: new threats lead to new resolutions, which create new structures, which in turn generate more meetings, reports and – ultimately – more rhetoric. This institutional momentum often outlasts the crises that triggered it, embedding counter-terrorism more deeply into the UN’s architecture.

The analysis draws out five key insights: 

1️⃣ Rhetorical leadership has shifted between major powers: While the US led initial efforts, Russia and China now dominate the discourse. 
2️⃣ Discourse drove institutional expansion: Institutional growth followed rhetorical trends.
3️⃣ Counter-terrorism at the UN is a self-sustaining agenda: Counter-terrorism discourse has become routinised and institutionalised, even during periods when the overall trend of ‘terror’ attacks declined.
4️⃣ The UN had a role in the expansion of counter-terrorism architecture: The Secretariat and UN entities have made strategic choices that deepened engagement with counter-terrorism, reflecting institutional incentives.
5️⃣ Not all concepts endure: Terms like ‘radicalisation’ remain contested and have not gained the same institutional traction as ‘terror’ or ‘extremism’.

Geneva, 4th October, 2025: The United Kingdom (UK) and Somalia yesterday co-hosted an official side event at the ongoing 60th session of the UN Human Rights Council in Geneva under the theme “Somalia’s Human Rights Transition: From Country-Specific Mandate to Strengthened National Institutions and International Human Rights Mechanism.”

The event featured addresses by the Somali Minister of Family and Human Development, Khadija Mohamed Al-Makhzoumi and the UK Ambassador for Human Rights, Eleanor Sanders. It drew a packed audience of member states, international organisations and civil society representatives. Among the invited panellists was Omar Faruk Osman, Secretary General of the National Union of Somali Journalists (NUSOJ), who delivered a powerful statement on Somalia’s human rights transition.

Osman acknowledged the progress Somalia has made, including the establishment of the independent National Human Rights Commission, the adoption of new laws and policies, and the development of a transitional roadmap for human rights. He commended the Ministry and Government for creating space for civil society engagement. He stressed that constructive partnership, not hollow lamentation, is the only way Somalia can advance towards a rights-respecting future.

At the same time, Osman warned that progress cannot conceal the stark realities of Somalia’s human rights situation, particularly the crisis of media freedom. “The killing of journalists may have declined, but repression is evolving and expanding,” he said. “Intimidation, arbitrary arrests, beatings, media bans, censorship, threats and both online and offline harassment against women journalists are now widespread and escalating across the country. Because of the deeply ingrained culture of impunity, those responsible for the murders of journalists over the past 15 years have escaped punishment, even though the UN Human Rights Council has been informed of these crimes year after year”.

He pointed to the 1964 Penal Code, the revised 2020 Media Law and the Anti-Terrorism Law as examples of Somalia’s antiquated and oppressive legal system as a significant barrier. These laws undermine the legitimacy of any human rights transition, he cautioned, which still criminalise journalism and restrict freedom of expression. “Journalists continue to be dragged before courts under draconian provisions designed to silence dissent. As long as these laws remain in force, media freedom will remain under attack and civic space under siege,” he said.

The NUSOJ Secretary General called for urgent reforms, including the domestication of international human rights conventions and the extension of a standing invitation to all UN Special Procedures Mandate Holders. He particularly urged Somalia to allow visits by the Special Rapporteur on Freedom of Expression, the Special Rapporteur on Human Rights Defenders and the Special Rapporteur on Freedom of Association to examine the situation first-hand.

Osman also expressed appreciation to the United Kingdom for its consistent leadership in advocating for the protection of human rights in Somalia at the global level. He concluded with a firm message: “When progress is made, we will commend it. We will not remain silent when violations persist and abuses occur. We will raise our voice, call it out and demand accountability.”

The discussion in Geneva highlighted that while Somalia has taken essential steps on its human rights journey, the transition remains fragile and must be designed, perceived and implemented as a progressive one. Media freedom and civic space must be placed at the centre of reform efforts and the actualisation of the transition if the country is to achieve lasting protection of fundamental rights.

Muqdisho, Oktoobar 4, 2025; Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya Mudane Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa maanta khudbad ka jeediyey Shirka Iskaashiga Ganacsiga iyo Maalgashiga ee Soomaaliya iyo Maraykanka, kaas oo ku qabsoomay magaalada Muqdisho.

Waxaa xusid mudan in argagixisadu adeegsadeen gaari nooca Cabdi-Bilaha ah oo ay ku buufiyeen midabka iyo astaanta ciidamada amniga, islamarkaana ay xirnaayeen darees u eg direyska ciidamada. Weerarka argagixiso ee galabta dhacay wuxuu ka tarjumayaa rafashada cadawga argagixisada ah ee shalay, 03-da Oktoobar 2025, jab xooggan loogu geystay gobolka Shabeellaha Hoose, halkaas oo laga xoreeyay deegaannada Awdheegle, Raqayle, Shaangarre iyo Malabo.

 • Xeerka Amniga Xarumaha Dowladda (X.Lr. 134)
 • Xeerka Amniga Xarumaha Gaarka ah (X.Lr. 135)
 • Xeerka Xakameynta Hubka Caasimadda (X.Lr. 123)

UNICEF, together with child protection partners, held a three-day training on “I Support My Peers” under the Mental Health and Psychosocial Support (#MHPSS) initiative.

The training brought together 20 participants from Elman Peace, SOS Village, SWDC, and Intersom to strengthen their ability to support children and adolescents affected by conflict, displacement, family loss, and poverty.

Through interactive sessions, role-plays, and group reflections, participants gained practical skills in Psychological First Aid, active listening, setting personal boundaries, and peer-to-peer support.

The closing session emphasized the importance of self-care, peer networks, and community resilience in promoting children’s and adolescents’ wellbeing. Certificates were awarded to participants in recognition of their commitment and contributions.

Xafiiska Amniga Qaranka (XAQ) Soomaaliya ayaa qabtay kulan socondoona sadex maalmood kaas oo ay kaqayb galayaan wakiilo ka socda Xafiisyada Amniga Dowlad-Goboleedyada.

Kulanka ayaa diiradda lagu saarayaa diyaarinta hindise-sharciyeed ku saabsan dhismaha Guddiyada Amniga Dowlad-Goboleedyada , si loo xoojiyo nidaamka maamul ee amniga dalka.kulanka ayaa u jeedooyinka laga leeyahay waxaa kamid ah:

1. In la caddeeyo kaalinta Golaha Amniga Qaranka, Xafiiska Amniga Qaranka, iyo Xafiisyada Amniga Dowlad-goboleedyada ee ku jira Qaab-dhismeedka Amniga Qaranka ee la cusboonaysiiyay.

2. In la qeexo hawlaha guddiyada amniga heer federaal iyo heer dowlad-goboleed si loo dheellitiro baahida amniga gudaha iyo ilaalinta madax-bannaanida.

3. In la horumariyo habraacyo isku-xidhan oo siyaasadda iyo go’aan qaadashada u dhexeeya federaalka iyo dowlad-goboleedyada.

4. In la dhiso sharci aasaasi ah oo qeexaya awoodaha, qaab-dhismeedka xubinnimada, iyo hababka wada-shaqaynta.

5. In la abuuro habab isla-xisaabtan oo wax ku ool ah si looga hortago khataraha kooxaha hubeysan ee aan dawliga ahayn.

Geneva, Switzerland – Wasiirka Wasaaradda Qoyska iyo Horumarinta Xuquuqul Insaanka ee Xukuumadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Amb. Khadiija Maxamed Al-Makhzoumi, ayaa magaalada Geneva kulammo gaar ah kula qaadatay qaar ka mid ah safiirrada dalalka caalamka  u fadhiya xarunta Qaramada Midoobay ee Geneva. 

Kulammadan ayaa qayb ka ah ololaha ay Soomaaliya ka waddo magaalada Geneva, halkaas oo uu ka socdo Shirweynaha 60-aad ee Xuquuqul Insaanka Qaramada Midoobay (UN Human Rights Council).

Kulanka koowaad, Wasiiraddu waxay  la yeelatay  H.E. Naser Abdullah Alhayen, Safiirka Dowladda Kuwait ee Geneva. Kulanka labaadna waxay la qaadatay H.E. Dr. Hend Abdulrahman Al Muftah, Safiirka Dowladda Qatar ee Geneva, halka kulanka saddexaadna ay la yeelatay H.E. Ambassador Burak Akçapar, Safiirka Dowladda Turkey ee Geneva.

Safiirrada dalalkaasi waxay dhamaantood muujinayeen taageero buuxda oo ay u hayaan dadaallada ay Soomaaliya ku doonayso in ay dib u soo ceshato doorkeeda iyo madax-bannaanideeda ku aaddan waajibaadka qaran ee xuquuqul insaanka, ka dib muddo 30 sano ah oo ay ka maqneyd maareynta madax-bannaan ee arrintan muhiimka ah.

Dadaalladan ayaa qayb ka ah qorshaha ballaaran ee Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ee ku wajahan soo celinta kaalinteeda firfircoon ee Qaramada Midoobay, iyo xaqiijinta horumar ku dhisan ilaalinta xuquuqda aadanaha, caddaaladda iyo sinnaanta bulshada.

Waxaa la filayaa in maalinta Arbaco, 8-da Oktoobar 2025, la qabto codbixinta Golaha Xuquuqul Insaanka ee Qaramada Midoobay, taas oo Soomaaliya ay u tartamayso xubinnimo, iyadoo ololahan uu qayb weyn ka yahay dadaallada iyo kulammada diblumaasiyadeed ee ay Wasiiraddu hoggaamineyso.

The word ‘Mushrik’ comes from the term ‘Shirk’, which means associating someone with Allah or assigning partners with Him. Allah has promised never to forgive shirk, while He can forgive, if He wills, other sins, big or small.

He also stated :

> "Shirk is, in truth, a huge injustice. »

And again:

> "The associates are impure. »

This is what the shirk is.

Mogadishu, Somalia
October 08, 2025

The Federal Republic of Somalia values this milestone as a reflection of mutual trust and constructive dialogue between Somalia and its international partners. The transition from an independent expert mandate to a collaborative framework with the Office of the High Commissioner for Human Rights demonstrates growing national ownership, institutional maturity, and an evolving capacity to address human rights challenges through nationally driven solutions. 

The Federal Republic of Somalia expresses deep appreciation to all member states and partners who have supported this resolution and continue to stand with Somalia in its reform agenda.

Fadhigii 37-aad ee Shirka Golaha Wasiirrada Jammhuuriyadda Somaliland oo uu Shir-gudoominayey Madaxweyne ku-xigeenka Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland, ahna KU-SIMAHA Madaxweynaha JSL, Mudane Maxamed Cali Aw Cabdi ayaa maanta ka qabsoomay Qasriga Madaxtooyada Somaliland. 

Qodobbada maanta lagaga wada hadlay Fadhigii 37-aad  waxa ka mid ahaa: 

𝟏. 𝐖𝐚𝐫𝐛𝐢𝐱𝐢𝐧𝐭𝐚 𝐗𝐚𝐚𝐥𝐚𝐝𝐝𝐚 𝐀𝐦𝐧𝐢𝐠𝐚 𝐝𝐚𝐥𝐤𝐚:

Waxa ka war bixiyey Wasiirka Wasaaradda Arrimaha Gudaha iyo Amniga Mudane Cabdalle Maxamed Carab, isaga oo sheegay in guud ahaanba amniga dalku uu sugan yahay, isla markaana aanay jirin wax qalalaase ama xasilooni darro ah nooc kasta oo ay tahayba oo ka jira Dalka JSL. 

Dhinaca kale, Wasiir Cabdalle waxa uu sheegay in ay dalka ka jirto deggenaansho siyaasadeed oo buuxda. Wasiirku waxa uu Golaha u sheegay in Shir doceedyadii Gogosha Nabadda ee uu Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland dhigay magaalada Ceerigaabo ay si habsami leh u socdaan. Wasiirku waxa uu sheegay in Shilalka Gaadiidku ay noqdeen mushkilad Qaran oo u baahan in Qaran ahaan si wadajir ah wax laga qabto. 

𝟐. 𝐖𝐚𝐫𝐛𝐢𝐱𝐢𝐧𝐭𝐚 𝐀𝐫𝐫𝐢𝐦𝐚𝐡𝐚 𝐃𝐡𝐚𝐪𝐚𝐚𝐥𝐚𝐡𝐚, 𝐌𝐚𝐚𝐥𝐢𝐲𝐚𝐝𝐝𝐚 𝐢𝐲𝐨 𝐃𝐚𝐤𝐡𝐥𝐢𝐠𝐚:
Waxa ka war bixiyey Wasiirka Wasaaradda Maaliyadda iyo Horumarinta Dhaqaalaha JSL, Mudane Cabdilaahi Xasan Aadan. Wasiirku waxa uu Golaha si guud ugaga xog warramay hab-sami-u-socodka ururinta Cashuuraha Berriga iyo kaalinta ay ku leeyihiin kobaca dhaqaalaha dalka. Wasiirku waxa uu sheegay in xaaladda dakhliga iyo dhaqaalaha dalka ay u socdaan sidii loogu talo galay, isaga oo sheegay in ay jirto korodh muuqda oo ku yimid dakhliga gudaha, sidoo kalena ay sii xoogaysanayso xasiloonida dhaqaale ee dalka JSL. 

Sidoo kale, Wasiirku waxa uu xusay in Dawladda Somaliland ay mudnaanta siineyso wax-soo-saarka iyo maalgashiga gudaha, kobcinta ganacsiga, iyo abuurista istiraatijiyado Qaran oo lagu kobcinayo dhaqaalaha Dalka. 

Dhinaca kale, Wasiiru-Dawlaha  Maaliyadda iyo Horumarinta Dhaqaalaha, Mudane Ismaaciil Mawliid Cabdilaahi ayaa isaguna Golaha siiyey warbixin gaar ah oo ku saabsan halbeegyada maaliyadeed (metrics) ee muhiimka u ah dhaqaalaha dalka. Wasiiru-Dawluhu waxa uu Golaha siiyey warbixin aqooneed oo la xidhiidha afar qaybood oo waaweyn: 

𝟭. 𝗙𝗶𝗻𝗮𝗻𝗰𝗶𝗮𝗹 𝗦𝗲𝗰𝘁𝗼𝗿 𝗠𝗲𝘁𝗿𝗶𝗰𝘀
𝟮. 𝗧𝗿𝗮𝗱𝗲 𝗮𝗻𝗱 𝗧𝗿𝗮𝘃𝗲𝗹 𝗠𝗲𝘁𝗿𝗶𝗰𝘀
𝟯. 𝗜𝗻𝘃𝗲𝘀𝘁𝗺𝗲𝗻𝘁 𝗠𝗲𝘁𝗿𝗶𝗰𝘀
𝟰. 𝗙𝗶𝘀𝗰𝗮𝗹 𝗠𝗲𝘁𝗿𝗶𝗰𝘀.

Wasiiru-Dawluhu waxa uu sheegay in xogtani ay muhiim u tahay Dejinta Siyaasadaha dhaqaale iyo go’aannada istaraatiijiga ah ee Dakhliga gudaha iyo kobcinta dhaqaalaha Qaranka. 

𝟑. 𝐖𝐚𝐫𝐛𝐢𝐱𝐢𝐧𝐭𝐚 𝐗𝐚𝐚𝐥𝐚𝐝𝐝𝐚 𝐀𝐛𝐚𝐚𝐫𝐚𝐡𝐚 𝐃𝐚𝐥𝐤𝐚:
Waxa ka war bixiyey Wasiirka Diinta iyo Awqaafta JSL, Mudane Sheekh Cabdullaahi Baashe Daahir Jaamac  oo ah Xubin ka tirsan Guddida Gurmadka Abaaraha Heer Qaran. Wasiirku waxa uu sheegay in roobku uu ka da'ay meelo badan oo ka mid ah Gobollada dalka, laakiin ay weli Gobollada Bariga dalka ka jirto biyo yaraan. Wasiirku waxa uu Golaha u sheegay in dedaallada Gurmadka Abaaruhu si wacan u socdaan, gaar ahaan qaybinta deeqaha raashinka oo la gaadhsiiyey meelaha ay ka jiraan baahiyaha ugu badani iyo Dayactirka Ceelasha Biyaha. 

𝟒. 𝐖𝐚𝐫𝐛𝐢𝐱𝐢𝐧 𝐥𝐚 𝐱𝐢𝐝𝐡𝐢𝐢𝐝𝐡𝐚 𝐡𝐚𝐛-𝐬𝐚𝐦𝐢-𝐮-𝐬𝐨𝐜𝐨𝐝𝐤𝐚 𝐒𝐢𝐲𝐚𝐚𝐬𝐚𝐝𝐝𝐚 𝐀𝐫𝐫𝐢𝐦𝐚𝐡𝐚 𝐃𝐢𝐛𝐞𝐝𝐝𝐚:
Waxa ka war bixiyey Wasiirka Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda iyo Iskaashiga Caalamiga JSL, Mudane Cabdiraxmaan Daahir Aadan.
Wasiirku ayaa Golaha siiyey warbixin nuxur leh oo ku saabsan xaaladda guud ee Siyaasadda Arrimaha Dibedda iyo Xidhiidhada Caalamiga ah, iyo dedaallada socda ee lagu xoojinayo mowqifka Somaliland ee aqoonsi raadiska iyo iskaashiga arrimaha horumarka bulshada. Wasiirku waxa uu hoosta ka xarriiqay in dedaallada aqoonsiga Somaliland ee ay horseedka ka yihiin Goleyaasha Sharci Dejinta ee dalka Mareykanku ay u socdaan si wacan. 

Wasiirku waxa uu sheegay in Wasaaraddu ay si joogto ah ugu hawlan tahay xoojinta xidhiidho diblomaasiyadeed iyo wada-hadallo istaraatiiji ah oo lala yeelanayo Dawladaha saaxiibka la ah Somaliland iyo Hay’adaha Caalamiga ah, kuwaasi oo diiradda lagu saarayo: 

1. Dhiirrigelinta iyo Dardargelinta Aqoonsiga Caalamiga ah ee Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland.
2. Kor u qaadista Sumcadda iyo Muuqaalka Wanaagsan ee Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland ee bulshada caalamka, gaar ahaan arrimaha khuseeya nabadda, xasilloonida, Dimuqraadiyadda iyo ku dhaqanka Sharciga.
3. Kobcinta xidhiidhka siyaasadeed, ka maalgashi iyo ka ganacsi ee ay Somaliland iyo dalalka caalamka.
4. Ka qaybgalka iyo ka muuqashada Madalaha Caalamiga ah, si loo muujiyo Mawqifka iyo Madax bannaanida Somaliland. 

𝟓. 𝐖𝐚𝐫𝐛𝐢𝐱𝐢𝐧𝐭𝐚 𝐗𝐚𝐚𝐥𝐚𝐝𝐝𝐚 𝐆𝐮𝐮𝐝 𝐞𝐞 𝐂𝐚𝐚𝐟𝐢𝐦𝐚𝐚𝐝𝐤𝐚 𝐝𝐚𝐥𝐤𝐚 𝐉𝐒𝐋:
Waxa ka war bixiyey Wasiirka Wasaaradda Horumarinta Caafimaadka JSL, Mudane Dr. Xuseen Bashiir Xirsi. Wasiirku waxa uu xusay in Wasaaraddu ay xoogga saarayso tayaynta adeegyada caafimaadka dalka, ballaadhinta xarumaha caafimaadka, iyo kor u qaadista aqoonta shaqaalaha Wasaaradda Caafimaadka. 
Wasiirku waxa uu tilmaamay in muddadii ay jirtay Xukuumadda cusubi ay adeegyada caafimaadka guud ahaan soo hagaagayaan, gaar ahaan dhinacyada hooyada iyo dhallaanka, tallaalka, iyo la dagaallanka cudurrada faafa. 
Sidoo kale, Wasiirku waxa uu sheegay in Wasaaraddu ay si dhow ula shaqeyso Hay’adaha Caalamiga ah iyo kuwa Maxalliga ah si loo xaqiijiyo adeeg caafimaad oo hufan, oo daboola baahiyaha xagga Caafimaadka bulshada.

Mogadishu, Somalia
October 09, 2025

The Federal Republic of Somalia expresses its profound appreciation for the regional and international efforts that led to the recent agreement reached in Sharm El-Sheikh, Arab Republic of Egypt, which includes key provisions aimed at a ceasefire, facilitating the delivery of humanitarian aid, releasing prisoners and detainees, and resuming political negotiations under international sponsorship. Somalia hopes that this agreement will serve as a genuine step towards achieving a just and comprehensive peace that ends the suffering of the Palestinian people and consolidates security and stability in the region.

Somalia reiterates its steadfast support for the legitimate rights of the Palestinian people, foremost among them their right to establish an independent and sovereign state. This principled stance reflects Somalia’s firm commitment to international legitimacy and to the values of dignity, justice, and peaceful coexistence.

The Federal Republic of Somalia expresses its full support for all efforts and initiatives aimed at protecting human dignity, reinforcing respect for international law, and contributing effectively to advancing a just and comprehensive resolution of the Palestinian cause.

3- Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa khudbad ka jeediyey Shirka Iskaashiga Ganacsiga iyo Maalgashiga ee Soomaaliya iyo Maraykanka,isagoo xusay in Soomaaliya ay mudnaanta siin doonto horumarinta kaabeyaasha dhaqaalaha iyo tiknoolajiyadda casriga ah, maalgelinta beeraha, kalluumaysiga iyo tamarta iyo abuurista fursado shaqo oo dhalinyarada.

4- Madaxweyne  Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud oo khudbad u  jeediyay shacabka Soomaaliyeed, kaddib, Salaaddii Jimcaha ayaa ka hadlay arrimaha ammaanka, tanaasulka dowladda ee tabashooyinka mucaaradka, nidaaminta dhulka danta guud iyo dhacdooyinkii amni-darro ee caasimadda ka dhacay maalmihii lasoo dhaafay.

5- Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa si buuxda u beenisay  warbixinnada saxaafadeed ee dhowaan lagu sheegay in Soomaaliya iyo Sweden ay wada galeen “heshiis qarsoodi ah” oo isku xiraya gargaarka horumarineed iyo dib-u-celinta muwaadiniinta Soomaaliyeed ee ku sugan dalka Sweden.

6- Ra’iisul Wasaare  Xamsa Cabdi Barre ayaa u magacaabay  Maxamed Xasan Cabdulle in uu noqda Agaasimaha Guud ee Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Waraabka.

7- Ra’iisul Wasaare Xamsa Cabdi Barre ayaa  daah-furay qorshaha dib loogu furay waddooyinka xiran ee caasimadda, oo gaaraya 52 waddo, kuwaas oo 15-kii sano ee la soo dhaafay u xirnaa sababo amni.

8- Ra’iisul Wasaare Xamsa Cabdi Barre ayaa sheegay in qorshaha furitaanka waddooyinka caasimadda uu ku yimid isbeddel iyo horumar muuqda oo laga sameeyey amniga caasimadda, taas oo keentay in laga maarmo xirnaanshaha waddooyinka.

9- Ra’iisul Wasaare Ku-Xigeenka Soomaaliya Mudane Saalax Axmed Jamaac   ayaa uga warbixiyey culimada iyo ganacsatada ku nool gobolka Minnesota ee dalka Maraykanka , xaaladda guud ee dalka, gaar ahaan dhinacyada amniga, siyaasadda, dhaqaalaha iyo horumarrada kala duwan ee ay xaqiijisay dowladda.

10- Ra’iisul Wasaare Ku-Xigeenka 2aad ee Soomaaliya Mudane Jibriil Cabdirashiid Xaaji Cabdi  ayaa tababar u soo xiray saraakiil, saraakiil-xigeenno iyo cutubyo ka tirsan ciidanka Gorgor ee Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliya, kuwaas oo tababbaro kala duwan ku soo qaatay dalka Turkiga iyo Kuliyadda Tababbarka Ciidamada ee Turkiga (TurkSom).

11- Golaha Wasiirrada ayaa  ansixiyay heshiisyo  ku saabsan  tacliinta sare, cilmi baarista iyo waxbarashada oo lala  galay dalalka Uganda, Qatar iyo Algeria.

12- Wasiirka Gaashaandhigga Mudane Axmed Macallin Fiqi ayaa magaalada Muqdisho ku qaabilay dhiggiisa Boqortooyada Sweden Pål Jonson, oo booqasho rasmi ah ku yimid dalka, iyagoo ka wada hadlay iskaashiga dhinacyada ammaanka iyo la dagaalanka argagaxisada Al-Shabaab.

13- Wasiirka Amniga Gudaha   Cabdullaahi Sheekh Ismaaciil (Fartaag) ayaa   magaalada Kampala kulan kula yeeshay Wasiirka Amniga ee Jamhuuriyadda Uganda, Hon Jim Katugugu Muhwezi,iyagoo ka wada hadlay iskaashiga dhinacyada  amniga, la dagaalanka kooxaha argagixisada iyo isdhaafsiga macluumaadka sirdoonka.

14- Wasiirka Caafimaadka iyo Daryeelka Bulshadaa Dr. Cali Xaaji Aadan  ayaa magaalada Amman kulan kula yeeshay Wasiirka Caafimaadka ee Jordan Dr. Ibraahim Mahfuz Al-Badour.

15- Wasiirka Hawlaha Guud  Cilmi Maxamuud Nuur ayaa sheegay in dowladda Soomaaliya ay billaabayso mashaariic  horumarineed oo  dhismaha waddooyinka  iyo biya-mareenada caasimada Moqdisho wax looga qabanayo. 

16- Taliyaha Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed Sarreeye Gaas Odawaa Yuusuf Raage ayaa magaalada Kigali kulan kula yeeshay Wasiirka Difaaca Dalka Rwanda  Juvenal Marizamunda, iyo Taliyaha Guud ee Ciidanka Difaaca Rwanda, General MK Mubarakh.

17- Wasiirka Wasaaradda Qoyska iyo Horumarinta Xuquuqul Insaanka marwo  Khadiija Maxamed Al-Makhzuumi ayaa magaalada Geneva kulamo gaar ah kula qaadatay qaar ka mid ah safiirrada dalalka caalamka u fadhiya xarunta Qaramada Midoobay ee Geneva.

18- Wasiirka Qorshaynta Maxamuud Cabdiraxmaan Sheekh Faarax (Beenebeene) iyo George Conway oo ah Ku-Xigeenka Wakiilka Xoghayaha Guud ee Qaramada Midoobay ayaa si wadajir ah u guddomiyey shirka Maamulka Sanduuqa Wadajirka Soomaaliya ee (SJF),oo looga hadlay  Barnaamijka Taageerada Dowlad-Dhiska iyo Dib-u-heshiisiinta (SPSP).

19-  Wasiirka Maaliyadda Mudane Biixi Imaan Cige ayaa Labada Gole ee Baarlamaanka Soomaaliya hor-geeyay hannaanka xisaab xirka Warbixin Maaliyadeedkii 2024.

20- Wasiirka Cadaaladda iyo Arrimaha Dastuurka Mudane Xasan Macallin Maxamuud ayaa horgeeyay Golaha Aqalka Sare ee Baarlamaanka Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya Hindise-Sharciyeedka Caddaaladda Da’yarta Soomaaliyeed.

21- Wasiirka Isgaarsiinta iyo Tiknoolojiyadda Mudane Maxamed Aadan Macallin ayaa  kulan la yeeshay Danjiraha cusub ee Midowga Yurub u fadhiya Soomaaliya, Amb.Francesca Di Mauro,iyadoo kulanka diirada lagu saaray dhinacyada isgaarsiinta, casriyeynta taknoolijiyada iyo ka hortagga ammaanka internet-ka. 

22-  Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda Soomaaliya Mudane Cabdisalaan Cabdi Cali  ayaa Muqdisho ku soo dhoweeyay 148 muwaadiniin Soomaali ah, kuwaas oo ku dhibaateysnaa dalka Yeman oo ay dowladdu ku guuleysatay in ay dib ugu soo celiso dalkooda.

37- Xoghayaha Joogtada ee Wasaaradda Caddaaladda iyo Arrimaha Dastuurka Faysal Aadan Xasan ayaa furay kulan dadweyne oo ku saabsan Kaalinta Bulshada ee ku aaddan Horrumarinta Cadaaladda.

38- Guddoomiyaha Hay’adda Maareynta Masiibooyinka Qaranka Mudane Maxamuud Macalin Cabdulle ayaa soo xiray shirkii ugu horreeyay ee lagu dhisayo Madasha Isku-xirka Nidaamyada Digniinaha Hore ee Khatarta Badan ee Soomaaliya, kaas oo socday muddo Shan maalmood ah.

39- Taliyaha Ciidanka Booliska Soomaaliyeed, S/Guuto Asad Cismaan Cabdullaahi ayaa shir guddoomiyay kulanka toddobaadlaha ah ee amniga Caasimadda.

40- Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliya oo kaashanaya howlgalka AUSSOM ayaa la wareegay degmada muhiimka ah ee Awdheegle ee gobolka Shabeellaha Hoose.

41-  Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliya ayaa  maleeshiyaadka Khawaarijta ka saaray deegaanno hoostaga degmada Awdheegle ee Gobolka Shabeellada Hoose oo muddooyinkii dambe ay argagaxisada ka dhigaanayeen gabbaad.

42- Wasaaradda Caddaaladda iyo Arrimaha Dastuurka Soomaaliya ayaa Muqdisho uga furtay hawlwadeenada xabsiyada dalka.

Federal Government of Somalia’s Weekly Briefing
Mogadishu, Friday, 10th  October, 2025

1- President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud opened the Regional Trade Cooperation Conference in East African Community held in Mogadishu.

2- President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud concluded Phase 1 of the talks held in Kismayo with the Jubaland State administration, with assurances that the consultations will continue.

3-  President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud delivered a speech at the Somalia-USA Trade and Investment Conference, noting that Somalia will prioritize developing economic infrastructure and modern technology, investing in agriculture, fishing, and energy, and creating employment opportunities for the youth.

4- President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud addressed the Somali people after Friday prayers, speaking on security matters, the government’s reconciliation with opposition, formalizing public land, and security incidents in the capital in recent days.

5- The Federal Government of Somalia has fully denied recent press reports claiming that Somalia and Sweden had entered into a “secret agreement” linking development aid and the repatriation of Somali citizens in Sweden.

6- Prime Minister Hamza Abdi Barre appointed Mohamed Hassan Abdulle as the new Director General of the Ministry of Agriculture and Irrigation.

7- Prime Minister Hamza Abdi Barre inaugurated the plan to reopen blocked roads in the capital, totaling 52 streets, which had been closed for security reasons for the past 15 years.

8- Prime Minister Hamza Abdi Barre stated that the reopening plan for the capital’s roads came about due to changes and visible security improvements in the capital, leading to the lifting of road closures.

9- Deputy Prime Minister Salah Ahmed Jama provided a briefing to scholars and businessmen living in the Minnesota region of the United States on the country’s general situation, especially in security, politics, economy, and notable progress achieved by the Federal Government of Somalia.

10- Deputy Prime Minister  Jibril Abdirashid Haji Abdi, organized training for officers, deputy officers, and units of the Gorgor forces of the Somali National Army, who received various trainings in Turkey and at the Turkish Army Training College (TurkSom).

11- The Cabinet of the Federal Republic of Somalia has approved agreements on higher education, research, and schooling with Uganda, Qatar, and Algeria.

12- Defense Minister Ahmed Moalim Fiqi hosted his counterpart from the Kingdom of Sweden, Pål Jonson, in Mogadishu for an official visit, where they discussed security cooperation and counter-terrorism against Al-Shabab.

13- Internal Security Minister Abdullahi Sheikh Ismail met in Kampala with Uganda’s Interior Minister Jim Katugugu Muhwezi, discussing security cooperation, combating terrorist groups, and intelligence exchanges.

14- Minister of Health and Community Care Dr.Ali Haji Adan met in Amman with Jordan’s Minister of Health Dr. Ibrahim Mahfuz Al-Badour.

15- Minister of Public Works Elmi Mohamud Nur said that the government will start development projects to repair roads and water channels in Mogadishu.

16- Somali Army Chief of Staff Lieutenant General Odowaa Yusuf Rage met in Kigali with Rwanda’s Defense Minister Juvenal Marizamunda and Rwanda’s Defense Forces Chief General MK Mubarakh.

17- Minister of Family and Human Rights Khadiija Mohamed Al-Makhzuumi held special meetings in Geneva with some of the ambassadors accredited to the United Nations.

18- Planning Minister Mohamud Abdirahman Sheikh Abdirahman and George Conway, Deputy SRSG to Somalia, jointly chaired the Somalia Joint Fund (SJF) meeting to discuss the Stabilization and Reconciliation Support Program (SPSP).

19- Finance Minister Bihi Iman Ige presented to both houses of the Somali Parliament the 2024 Financial Audit Plan.

20- Justice and Constitutional Affairs Minister Hassan Moalim Mohamud presented to the Senate a proposed law on youth justice in Somalia.

21- Communications and Technology Minister Mohamed Aden Moalim held a meeting with the new EU Ambassador to Somalia, Francesca Di Mauro, focusing on communications, modernization of technology, and safeguarding online security.

22- Somalia’s Foreign Minister Abdisalam Abdi Ali welcomed 148 Somalis who had been stranded in Yemen and were repatriated back by the Somali government.

23- Minister of Interior Ali Yusuf Ali (Hosh) participated in a ceremony welcoming the Speaker of the North-East Somalia State Parliament Dr. Adan Abdullahi Aw Hassan.

24- Minister of Justice and Constitutional Affairs Minister Hassan Moalim Mohamud delivered a speech at the opening of the conference establishing the Middle East and North Africa Network for Recovering Stolen Assets (MENA-ARIN) in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia.

25- The United Nations Human Rights Council adopted an important resolution granting Somalia responsibility for managing its national human rights obligations, which was under the UN since 1993.

26- Minister of Family and Human Rights Amb.Khadiija Al-Makhzoumi welcomed the UN resolution reestablishing Somalia’s role in national human rights obligations.

27- The East Africa Economic Community conference on trade held in Mogadishu concluded, focusing on boosting regional production.

28- Defense Minister, Amb. Ahmed Moalim Fiqi said the government plans to establish a dedicated welfare agency for the orphans of fallen Somali National Army soldiers to care for them.

29- Health and Social Care Minister Dr. Ali Haji Aden, participating in the Muslim World Health Ministers Conference in Amman, Jordan, held important bilateral meetings with health ministers from Malaysia and Brunei Darussalam.

30- National Security Advisor Amb. Aweys Haji Yusuf has closed a two-day bilateral meeting with security officials from the National Security Office and the security offices of the Federal Member States.

31- Mogadishu Port General Director Amb. Mohamed Ali Nur welcomed Somali businessmen who recently participated in the Somalia-USA Trade and Investment Conference in Mogadishu.

32- The Head of Immigration and Citizenship Authority, Mustafe Dhuhulow held productive talks with Qatar and Italy’s ambassadors in Somalia about enhancing immigration services between Somalia and those countries.

33- The Ministry of Security issued a statement about the Al-Shabab Kharijites attack on the Jilacow NISA Center, stating that all seven perpetrators were killed.

34- State Minister of Interior, Federal Affairs and Reconciliation Sadad Mohamed Nur attended the 76th session of the UNHCR Executive Committee in Geneva, Switzerland.
35- Somalia’s ambassador to Algeria Yusuf Ahmed Hassan met with Algeria’s Police Chief Ali Badawi.

36- Deputy Foreign Affairs and International Cooperation Minister Isaq Mohamud Mursal officially opened Somalia Day at Expo 2025 in Osaka, Japan.

37- Permanent Secretary of the Ministry of Justice and Constitutional Affairs Faysal Adan Hassan opened a public meeting on the role of society in advancing justice.

38- Chairperson of the National Disaster Management Authority Mohamud Moalim Abdulle closed the first conference on building the Somalia Early Warning System for High-Risk Areas, held over five days.

39- Somali Police Chief General Asad Osman Cabdullaahi chaired the weekly security meeting of the capital.

40- The Somali National Army, in coordination with the AUSSOM operation, took control of the important town of Awdheegle in the Lower Shabelle region.

41- Somali National Army forces have kicked out Al Shabab Kharijites ilitants from areas under Awdheegle district in Lower Shabelle where they had used the area as a base.

42- The Ministry of Justice and Constitutional Affairs launched prison  officers’ training in Mogadishu.

43- The Ministry of Defense hosted a conference in Mogadishu on preventing child recruitment.

Dilihat detikSumut, Kamis (9/10/2025), pria itu mengunggah videonya di akun TikTok @tersadarkan5758. Saat itu, dia menjelaskan alasannya pindah agama dari Islam ke Kristen.

Dalam video itu yang ditonton 1,9 juta kali itulah dia diduga menghina Nabi Muhammad dan para mualaf. Video itu ramai dibagikan netizen serta dibanjiri komentar.

Saiful menilai, tindakan pelaku bukan hanya melanggar norma sosial dan nilai keislaman, tetapi juga dapat menimbulkan kegaduhan dan perpecahan di tengah masyarakat. Menurutnya, kebebasan berekspresi di ruang digital tidak boleh disalahgunakan untuk menyerang keyakinan agama orang lain.

"Kita harus introspeksi. Mengapa dari Aceh, yang dikenal dengan Syariat Islam-nya, bisa muncul konten seperti ini? Ini sinyal bahwa kita perlu memperkuat pendidikan agama dan karakter, terutama di kalangan anak muda," tutur Saiful.

*KALANGAN HABAIB SERUKAN UNTUK TIDAK MERAYAKAN MAULID NABI*

Jajaran Ulama dari kalangan Habaib menyerukan Ahlul Bait Rasulullah untuk tidak memperturuti hawa nafsu mereka. 

Karena Perayaan yang mereka sebut dengan Maulid Nabi dengan dalih Cinta Rasul, dan berbagai acara yang menyelisih syari’at, yang secara khusus dimeriahkan/ diperingati oleh sebagian anak keturunan Nabi yang mulia ini jelas merupakan sebuah penyimpangan, dan tidak sesuai dengan Maqasidu asy-Syar’I al-Muthahhar (tujuan-tujuan syari’at yang suci) untuk menjadikan ittiba’ (mengikuti) kepada Nabi Shallallahu ‘alaihi wasallam sebagai standar utama yang dijadikan rujukan oleh seluruh manusia dalam segala sikap dan perbuatan (ibadah) mereka.

Dalam sebuah pernyataan yang dilansir ” Islam Today “, para Habaib berkata, “Bahwa Kewajiban Ahlul Bait (Keturunan Rasulullah) adalah hendaklah mereka menjadi orang yang paling yang mulia dalam mengikuti Sunnah Beliau Shallallahu ‘alaihi wasallam, mengikuti petunjuknya, dan wajib atas mereka untuk merealisasikan cinta yang sebenarnya (terhadap beliau Shallallahu ‘alaihi wasallam, red), serta menjadi manusia yang paling menjauhi hawa nafsu. Karena Syari’at Islam datang untuk menyelisihi penyeru hawa nafsu, sedangkan cinta yang hakiki pasti akan menyeru Ittiba’ yang benar.

Mereka (Para Habaib) menambahkan : “Diantara fenomena yang menyakitkan adalah terlibatnya sebagian anak-cucu Rasulullah Shallallahu ‘alaihi wasallam yang mulia (Ahlul Bait) dalam berbagai macam penyimpangan syari’at, dan pengagungan terhadap syi’ar-syi’ar yang tidak pernah dibawa oleh Al-Habib al-Mushtafa Shallallahu ‘alaihi wasallam. Dan di antara syiar-syiar tersebut adalah bid’ah peringatan Maulid Nabi dengan dalih cinta.

Para Habaib menekankan dalam pernyataannya, bahwa yang membuat perayaan tersebut sangat jauh dari petunjuk Nabi Shallallahu ‘alaihi wasallam adalah karena hal itu dapat menyebabkan pengkultusan terhadap beliau Shallallahu ‘alaihi wasallam yang beliau sendiri tidak membolehkannya, bahkan tidak ridho dengan hal itu. Dan lainnya adalah bahwa peringatan tersebut dibangun di atas Hadits-hadits yang bathil dan aqidah-aqidah yang rusak. Telah valid dari Rasulullahu Shallallahu ‘alaihi wasallam akan pengingkaran terhadap sikap-sikap yang berlebihin seperti ini, dengan sabdanya :

"Janganlah kalian mengkultuskan aku seperti pengkultusan orang-orang nasrani terhadap putra maryam." (HR. Al-Bukhari).

Sedangkan seputar adanya preseden untuk perayaan-perayaan seperti itu pada as-Salafu ash-Shalih, Para Habaib tersebut mengatakan :

“Bahwa perayaan Maulid Nabi merupakan ibadah/ amalan yang tidak pernah dilakukan dan diperintahkan oleh Nabi Shallallahu ‘alaihi wasallam, dan tidak pernah pula dilakukan oleh seorangpun dari kalangan Ahlul Bait yang mulia, seperti Ali bin Abi Thalib, Hasan dan Husein, Ali Zainal Abidin, Ja’far ash-Shadiq, serta tidak pernah pula diamalkan oleh para Sahabat Nabi Shallallahu ‘alaihi wasallam radhiyallahu ‘anhum ajma’in, begitu pula tidak pernah diamalkan oleh seorang pun dari para tabi’in.

Para Habaib tersebut mengatakan kepada Ahlul Bait, Wahai Tuan-tuanYang terhormat! Wahai sebaik-baiknya keturunan di muka bumi, sesungguhnya kemulian Asal usul (Nasab) merupakan kemulian yang diikuti dengan taklif (pembebanan), yakni melaksanakan sunnah Rasululullah Shallallahu ‘alaihi wasallam, dan berusaha untuk menyempurnakan amanahnya setelah sepeninggalnya dengan menjaga agama dan menyebarkan dakwah yang dibawanya. Dan karena mengikuti apa yang tidak dibolehkan oleh syari’at tidak mendatangkan kebenaran sedikitpun, bahkan merupakan amalan yang ditolak oleh Allah Ta’ala, sebagaimana yang disabdakan oleh Rasulullah Shallallahu ‘alaihi wasallam :

Barangsiapa mengada-adakan sesuatu yang baru di dalam urusan (agama) kami ini yang bukan termasuk di dalamnya, maka ia tertolak. (HR. al-Bukhari dan Muslim)

Berikut ini adalah teks pernyataannya:
Risalah untuk Ahlul Bait (Anak-Cucu Rasulullah Shallallahu ‘alaihi wasallam) tentang Peringatan/ perayaan Maulid Nabi.

Diantara Prinsip-prinsip yang agung yang berpadu di atasnya hati-hati para ulama dan kaum Mukminin adalah meyakini (mengimani) bahwa petunjuk Nabi Muhammad Shallallahu ‘alaihi wasallam adalah petunjuk yang paling sempurna, dan syari’at yang beliau bawa adalah syari’at yang paling sempurna, Allah Ta’ala berfirman :

Pada hari ini telah Kusempurnakan untuk kamu agamamu dan telah Ku-cukupkan kepadamu nikmat-Ku, dan telah Ku-ridhai Islam itu jadi agamamu. (QS. Al-Maidah 3).

Dan meyakini (mengimani) bahwa mencintai Rasulullah Shallallahu ‘alaihi wasallam merupakan keyakinan atau tanda kesempurnaan iman seorang Muslim, Rasulullah Shallallahu ‘alaihi wasallam bersabda :

Tidak sempurna iman salah seorang di antara kamu sehingga aku lebih dia cintai dari ayahnya, anaknya, dan semua manusia. (HR. Al-Bukhari & Muslim).

Beliau adalah penutup para nabi, Imam orang-orang yang bertaqwa, Raja anak-cucu Adam, Imam Para Nabi jika mereka dikumpulkan, dan Khatib mereka jika mereka diutus, si empu Tempat yang Mulia, Telaga yang akan dikerumuni (oleh manusia), si empu bendera pujian, pemberi syafa’at manusia pada hari kiamat, dan orang yang telah menjadikan umatnya menjadi umat terbaik yang dikeluarkan untuk manusia, Allah Ta’ala berfirman :

"Sesungguhnya telah ada pada (diri) Rasulullah itu suri teladan yang baik bagimu (yaitu) bagi orang yang mengharap (rahmat) Allah dan (kedatangan) hari kiamat dan dia banyak menyebut Allah." (QS. l-Ahzab 21).

Dan di antara kecintaan kepada beliau adalah mencintai keluarga beliau (Ahlul Bait/ Habaib), Rasulullah Shallallahu ‘alaihi wasallam bersabda :

Aku mengingatkan kalian kepada Allah pada Ahlu Bait (keluarga)ku. (HR. Muslim).

Maka Kewajiban keluarga Rasulullah (Ahlul Bait/ Habaib) adalah hendaklah mereka menjadi orang yang paling yang mulia dalam mengikuti Sunnah Beliau Shallallahu ‘alaihi wasallam, mengikuti petunjuknya, dan wajib atas mereka untuk merealisasikan cinta yang sebenarnya (terhadap beliau Shallallahu ‘alaihi wasallam, red), serta menjadi manusia yang paling menjauhi hawa nafsu. Karena Syari’at datang untuk menyelisihi penyeru hawa nafsu, Allah Ta’ala berfirman :

Maka demi Rabbmu, mereka (pada hakekatnya) tidak beriman hingga mereka menjadikan kamu hakim dalam perkara yang mereka perselisihkan, kemudian mereka tidak merasa keberatan dalam hati mereka terhadap putusan yang kamu berikan, dan mereka menerima dengan sepenuhnya. (QS. An-Nisa’ 65).

Sedangkan cinta yang hakiki pastilah akan menyeru Ittiba’ yang benar. Allah Ta’ala berfirman:

Katakanlah : ”Jika kamu (benar-benar) mencintai Allah, ikutilah aku, niscaya Allah mengasihi dan mengampuni dosa-dosamu”. Allah Maha Pengampun lagi Maha Penyayang." (QS. Ali ‘Imran 31).

Tidak cukup hanya sekedar berafiliasi kepada beliau secara nasab, tetapi keluarga beliau (Ahlul bait) haruslah sesuai dengan al-haq (kebenaran yang beliau bawa) dalam segala hal, dan tidak menyalahi atau menyelisihinya.

Dan diantara fenomena menyakitkan adalah orang yang diterangi oleh Allah Ta’ala pandangannya dengan cahaya ilmu, dan mengisi hatinya dengan cinta dan kasih sayang kepada keluarga NabiNya (ahlul bait), khususya jika dia termasuk keluarga beliau pula dari keturunan beliau yang mulia adalah terlibatnya sebagian anak-cucu Rasulullah Shallallahu ‘alaihi wasallam yang mulia (Ahlul Bait/ Habaib) dalam berbagai macam penyimpangan syari’at, dan pengagungan terhadap syi’ar-syi’ar yang tidak pernah dibawa oleh Al-Habib al-Mushtafa Shallallahu ‘alaihi wasallam.

Dan di antara syi’ar-syi’ar yang diagungkan yang tidak berdasarkan petunjuk moyang kami Muhammad Shallallahu ‘alaihi wasallam tersebut adalah bid’ah peringatan Maulid Nabi dengan dalih cinta. Dan ini jelas merupakan sebuah penyimpangan terhadap prinsip yang agung, dan tidak sesuai dengan Maqasidu asy-Syar’I al-Muthahhar (tujuan-tujuan syari’at yang suci) untuk menjadikan ittiba’ (mengikuti) Nabi Shallallahu ‘alaihi wasallam sebagai standar utama yang dijadikan rujukan oleh seluruh manusia dalam segala sikap dan perbuatan (ibadah) mereka.

Dan tidak ada pertentangan antara mencintai beliau dengan mengikuti beliau shallallahu ‘alaihi wasallam, bahkan mengikuti (ittiba’) kepada beliau merupakan inti/ puncak kecintaan kepadanya. Dan orang yang mengikuti beliau secara benar (Ahlul ittiba’) adalah komitmen dengan sunnahnya, mengikuti petunjuknya, membaca sirah (perjalanan hidup)nya, mengharumi majlis-majlis mereka dengan pujian-pujian terhadapnya tanpa membatasi hari, berlebihan dalam menyifatinya serta menentukan tata cara yang tidak berdasar dalam syari’at Islam.

Maka bagaimana dengan faktanya, sebagian majlis dan puji-pujian dipenuhi dengan lafazh-lafazh bid’ah, dan istighatsah-istighatsah syirik.

Dan perayaan Maulid Nabi merupakan ibadah/ amalan yang tidak pernah dilakukan dan diperintahkan oleh Nabi Shallallahu ‘alaihi wasallam, dan tidak pernah pula dilakukan oleh seorangpun dari kalangan Ahlul Bait yang mulia, seperti ‘Ali bin Abi Thalib, Hasan dan Husein, Ali Zainal Abidin, Ja’far ash-Shadiq, serta tidak pernah pula diamalkan oleh para Sahabat Nabi Shallallahu ‘alaihi wasallam radhiyallahu ‘anhum ajma’in, begitu pula tidak pernah diamalkan oleh seorang pun dari para tabi’in, dan tidak pula Imam Madzhab yang empat, serta tidak seorangpun dari kaum muslimin pada periode-periode pertama yang diutamakan.

*KALANGAN HABAIB SERUKAN UNTUK TIDAK MERAYAKAN MAULID NABI*

Jajaran Ulama dari kalangan Habaib menyerukan Ahlul Bait Rasulullah untuk tidak memperturuti hawa nafsu mereka. 

Karena Perayaan yang mereka sebut dengan Maulid Nabi dengan dalih Cinta Rasul, dan berbagai acara yang menyelisih syari’at, yang secara khusus dimeriahkan/ diperingati oleh sebagian anak keturunan Nabi yang mulia ini jelas merupakan sebuah penyimpangan, dan tidak sesuai dengan Maqasidu asy-Syar’I al-Muthahhar (tujuan-tujuan syari’at yang suci) untuk menjadikan ittiba’ (mengikuti) kepada Nabi Shallallahu ‘alaihi wasallam sebagai standar utama yang dijadikan rujukan oleh seluruh manusia dalam segala sikap dan perbuatan (ibadah) mereka.

Dalam sebuah pernyataan yang dilansir ” Islam Today “, para Habaib berkata, “Bahwa Kewajiban Ahlul Bait (Keturunan Rasulullah) adalah hendaklah mereka menjadi orang yang paling yang mulia dalam mengikuti Sunnah Beliau Shallallahu ‘alaihi wasallam, mengikuti petunjuknya, dan wajib atas mereka untuk merealisasikan cinta yang sebenarnya (terhadap beliau Shallallahu ‘alaihi wasallam, red), serta menjadi manusia yang paling menjauhi hawa nafsu. Karena Syari’at Islam datang untuk menyelisihi penyeru hawa nafsu, sedangkan cinta yang hakiki pasti akan menyeru Ittiba’ yang benar.

Mereka (Para Habaib) menambahkan : “Diantara fenomena yang menyakitkan adalah terlibatnya sebagian anak-cucu Rasulullah Shallallahu ‘alaihi wasallam yang mulia (Ahlul Bait) dalam berbagai macam penyimpangan syari’at, dan pengagungan terhadap syi’ar-syi’ar yang tidak pernah dibawa oleh Al-Habib al-Mushtafa Shallallahu ‘alaihi wasallam. Dan di antara syiar-syiar tersebut adalah bid’ah peringatan Maulid Nabi dengan dalih cinta.

Para Habaib menekankan dalam pernyataannya, bahwa yang membuat perayaan tersebut sangat jauh dari petunjuk Nabi Shallallahu ‘alaihi wasallam adalah karena hal itu dapat menyebabkan pengkultusan terhadap beliau Shallallahu ‘alaihi wasallam yang beliau sendiri tidak membolehkannya, bahkan tidak ridho dengan hal itu. Dan lainnya adalah bahwa peringatan tersebut dibangun di atas Hadits-hadits yang bathil dan aqidah-aqidah yang rusak. Telah valid dari Rasulullahu Shallallahu ‘alaihi wasallam akan pengingkaran terhadap sikap-sikap yang berlebihin seperti ini, dengan sabdanya :

"Janganlah kalian mengkultuskan aku seperti pengkultusan orang-orang nasrani terhadap putra maryam." (HR. Al-Bukhari).

Sedangkan seputar adanya preseden untuk perayaan-perayaan seperti itu pada as-Salafu ash-Shalih, Para Habaib tersebut mengatakan :

“Bahwa perayaan Maulid Nabi merupakan ibadah/ amalan yang tidak pernah dilakukan dan diperintahkan oleh Nabi Shallallahu ‘alaihi wasallam, dan tidak pernah pula dilakukan oleh seorangpun dari kalangan Ahlul Bait yang mulia, seperti Ali bin Abi Thalib, Hasan dan Husein, Ali Zainal Abidin, Ja’far ash-Shadiq, serta tidak pernah pula diamalkan oleh para Sahabat Nabi Shallallahu ‘alaihi wasallam radhiyallahu ‘anhum ajma’in, begitu pula tidak pernah diamalkan oleh seorang pun dari para tabi’in.

Para Habaib tersebut mengatakan kepada Ahlul Bait, Wahai Tuan-tuanYang terhormat! Wahai sebaik-baiknya keturunan di muka bumi, sesungguhnya kemulian Asal usul (Nasab) merupakan kemulian yang diikuti dengan taklif (pembebanan), yakni melaksanakan sunnah Rasululullah Shallallahu ‘alaihi wasallam, dan berusaha untuk menyempurnakan amanahnya setelah sepeninggalnya dengan menjaga agama dan menyebarkan dakwah yang dibawanya. Dan karena mengikuti apa yang tidak dibolehkan oleh syari’at tidak mendatangkan kebenaran sedikitpun, bahkan merupakan amalan yang ditolak oleh Allah Ta’ala, sebagaimana yang disabdakan oleh Rasulullah Shallallahu ‘alaihi wasallam :

Barangsiapa mengada-adakan sesuatu yang baru di dalam urusan (agama) kami ini yang bukan termasuk di dalamnya, maka ia tertolak. (HR. al-Bukhari dan Muslim)

Risalah untuk Ahlul Bait (Anak-Cucu Rasulullah Shallallahu ‘alaihi wasallam) tentang Peringatan/ perayaan Maulid Nabi.

Diantara Prinsip-prinsip yang agung yang berpadu di atasnya hati-hati para ulama dan kaum Mukminin adalah meyakini (mengimani) bahwa petunjuk Nabi Muhammad Shallallahu ‘alaihi wasallam adalah petunjuk yang paling sempurna, dan syari’at yang beliau bawa adalah syari’at yang paling sempurna, Allah Ta’ala berfirman :

Pada hari ini telah Kusempurnakan untuk kamu agamamu dan telah Ku-cukupkan kepadamu nikmat-Ku, dan telah Ku-ridhai Islam itu jadi agamamu. (QS. Al-Maidah 3).

Tidak sempurna iman salah seorang di antara kamu sehingga aku lebih dia cintai dari ayahnya, anaknya, dan semua manusia. (HR. Al-Bukhari & Muslim).

Το ΕΚΑΣ (Επίδομα Κοινωνικής Αλληλεγγύης Συνταξιούχων) κόπηκε σταδιακά από το 2012 έως το 2019 για δημοσιονομικούς λόγους και στο πλαίσιο των μνημονιακών υποχρεώσεων της Ελλάδας προς την τρόικα. Αναλυτικά:

1. Πρώτες περικοπές – 2012 (κυβέρνηση Σαμαρά – ΝΔ/ΠΑΣΟΚ)

Με το μνημόνιο 2 και τον νόμο 4051/2012 ξεκίνησαν οι περικοπές για τις υψηλότερες συντάξεις.

Ο λόγος ήταν η μείωση του δημοσιονομικού ελλείμματος και οι απαιτήσεις της τρόικας για περιορισμό των προνοιακών δαπανών.

2. Σταδιακή κατάργηση – 2014–2015 (κυβέρνηση Σαμαρά/Μεταβατική κυβέρνηση)

Το ΕΚΑΣ μειώθηκε σταδιακά για μεγαλύτερο αριθμό συνταξιούχων.

Οι περικοπές επεκτάθηκαν για όσους είχαν υψηλότερο εισόδημα ή σύνταξη πάνω από συγκεκριμένα όρια.

3. Τελική κατάργηση – 2019 (κυβέρνηση ΣΥΡΙΖΑ, Τσίπρας)

Ο ΣΥΡΙΖΑ, αν και είχε δώσει προσωρινές ανακουφίσεις για χαμηλοσυνταξιούχους, πλήρωσε τα σπασμένα των προηγούμενων μνημονίων.

Η κατάργηση ήταν αναγκαστική, γιατί ήταν δεσμευμένη στα μνημόνια και στις συμφωνίες με τους θεσμούς, και η πλήρης εφαρμογή της είχε ήδη ξεκινήσει από προηγούμενες κυβερνήσεις.

Συμπέρασμα:
Το ΕΚΑΣ δεν το “έκοψε ο ΣΥΡΙΖΑ από επιλογή”, αλλά ήταν μνημονιακή υποχρέωση που είχαν ήδη ξεκινήσει οι προηγούμενες κυβερνήσεις (ΝΔ/ΠΑΣΟΚ) και η εφαρμογή της ολοκληρώθηκε επί ΣΥΡΙΖΑ.

During the past Ramadan, amidst many events and responsibilities, I found myself one day hesitant to visit my mother, may Allah forgive her and grant her  Firdaws. Fatigue had set in, and the schedule was overwhelming. Yet I felt unusually compelled to go, it was Friday, after ‘Asr, and something in my heart told me I must.

Upon arriving, I noticed two young brothers waiting patiently nearby. They approached me, and one of them told me he had learned that this visit was part of my daily routine. He had researched the cemetery, located my mother’s grave in that vast space, found the exact plot, and had been waiting there for most of the day, after traveling by plane solely to meet me.
May Allah forgive my mother, grant her al-Firdaws, and reward these brothers.

He told me he had made du‘ā to meet me, based on a certain stipulation about me: if our meeting was the answer to his du‘ā due to that specific condition, it would be all I could wish for dunya and akhira.

At the time, I was hesitant, this is, after all, a confirmed tactic the FBI has used dozens of times to entrap me. And I was also too occupied to sit with him properly, so he extended his stay. When I finally sat with him, saw his radiant face (Allāhumma bārik lahu), and heard his questions, I regretted not having dropped everything earlier to spend all my time with him.

His manners were remarkable, truly beyond his years. He was very young, only 18. His questions were the kind you love to hear: thoughtful, sincere, and filled with a genuine desire for knowledge. He wasn’t manhaj-shopping or hopping, nor was he chasing controversies or indulging in te back-and-forth games. He came to learn the dīn of Allah with humility and seriousness, and Allah knows best what is in the hearts.

As I dropped him off at the airport, I advised him to begin following the lessons, since he mentioned he hadn’t kept up with all the classes. He took that advice sincerely, he began studying and taking notes. Today, a video was sent to me of him completing the Tawheed class.

As he was leaving, he handed me a beautifully bound notebook filled with poems he had written, for me and about me. Allah is my witness: I am not worthy of a single letter within its pages. Yet it spoke volumes about the kind of heart he possesses.
O Allah, make me better than they think of me, forgive me for what they do not know, and do not hold me accountable for what they say.

When he would send me questions, months might pass before I could respond, yet he would wait patiently. May Allah bless him and forgive me for my shortcomings toward him.

When a debate was later announced, he didn’t play foolish games seeking attention, nor did he cozy up with the enemies, serving their evil agenda while pretending to be on the side of the truth. Instead, he knew his duty, simple and clear: to stand behind the truth.

Out of the hundreds of emails, texts, and calls I receive daily, he was, in fact, the only one who privately sent me a du‘ā by text regarding this matter, one that I woke up to. It was so beautifully worded, so sincere and heartfelt, that it genuinely soothed my heart.

It reminded me of the story of Qutaybah ibn Muslim and the du‘ā of Muḥammad ibn Wāsiʿ.
Ibn al-Jawzī mentioned in Ṣifat al-Ṣafwah that Muḥammad ibn Wāsiʿ was once with Qutaybah ibn Muslim in an army. Qutaybah was the governor of Khurāsān at the time, and the Turks had come out to confront them. So Qutaybah sent someone to the Masjid to see who was there. He was told, “No one is there except Muḥammad ibn Wāsiʿ, raising his finger in duaa'.”
Qutaybah then said:
“That finger of his is more beloved to me than thirty thousand cavalry.”
And in Siyar Aʿlām al-Nubalāʾ, Imām al-Dhahabī reported that Qutaybah said:
“That finger is more beloved to me than one hundred thousand drawn swords and strong young fighters.”

I ask Allah to reward his parents for such a noble upbringing, to keep him and his family steadfast, and to make him an ‘ālim and an imām of the Muslimeen.
May Allah honor me and surround me with such brothers. It is men of such character who, by the will of Allah, will be the catalysts of the awaited victory.
 
Once he completes what I advised him to pursue, it is brothers like this, sincere, disciplined, and grounded, whom I would be honored to teach. In fact, I would be the one asking to teach them.

On a side note: Many brothers have traveled from across the U.S., and even from abroad—to visit. May Allah reward the sincere among them. However, please only do so with my personal approval. I am not like others who have the support of Masaajid, means, resources, or the ease to accommodate so many visitors or students.

Ahmad Musa Jibril
Rabi’ II 17, 1447 AH

Kaafir bermakna "menutup". Siapapun mrk yg menolak/menutup diri dr kebenaran yg telah Allooh tampakkan maka sesungguhnya mrk adalah tergolong kaafir, walau pelakunya mnyandang gelar kehormatan sebagai ulama.

Kendati demikian setiap kita walau mengetahui ada tanda2 kekafiran pada seseorang tentu kita tdk berhak alias tdk halal menuduh orang tsb dgn tuduhan "kaafir". Biarkan Tuhan saja yg memvonisnya. Dan sikap kita hy perlu waspada dr orang sprt itu, agar kita tdk terbawa atau tertular dr prilakunya yg dapat mnyebabkan jatuh pada kekafiran. Krn orang sprt itu bukan saja membahayakan dirinya di sisi Allooh, akan tetapi jika yg bersangkutan memiliki gelar kehormatan dlm bidang keagamaan bisa sangat berpotensi mempengaruhi orang lain yg menta'diminya (inilah sejatinya ulama suu').

Yang terpenting bagi kita adalah jaga diri kita dr prilaku apapun yg dapat mnyebabkan jatuhnya diri pada kekafiran dlm pandangan Allooh.

Jika kita berbicara tentang kafir, jangan lalu kita berasumsi bahwa kafir itu adalah hanya di arahkan kpd mrk yg bukan beragama islam.
Perlu kita sadari bersama, sejatinya kata "kafir" yg Allooh sebutkan dlm AlQuran alkariim bukan saja di tujukan kpd mrk di luar islam, akan tetapi itu adalah merupakan peringatan keras dr Allooh utk kita yg beragama islam sekalipun, agar kita tdk terjebur dlm kekafiran krn menolak kebenaran. Dalam hal ini Tentu Allooh berharap agar kita tdk menutup diri ("kaafir") dr kebenaran yg di sampaikan oleh siapapun. Krn hakikatnya kebenaran lewat ilmu yg Allooh tampakkan dlm persoalan apapun itu datangnya dr Allooh. Maka menutup diri alias menolak kebenaran bisa berakibat kafir walau mrk mengaku muslim.

Hal itu terjadi karena pihak-pihak hizbiyin memberikan kepadanya pekerjaan, jabatan, kendaraan, atau dukungan materi lainnya. Terkadang ia diangkat menjadi pemimpin di sebuah lembaga milik para hizbiyin di negerinya, atau mendapatkan fasilitas lain yang menjadikannya condong kepada mereka.

Tidak jarang, ia pun bergabung dengan yayasan-yayasan hizbiyah yang telah dikenal luas. Yayasan tersebut memberikan dukungan, janji, atau harapan—seperti membangunkan markaz untuknya, membantu pembangunan masjid, atau proyek-proyek lain—yang akhirnya menyeretnya untuk menjual dakwah yang haq. Padahal dahulu ia membela kebenaran dan memusuhi kebatilan semata karena Allah.

Akan tetapi kini, ia justru berada di barisan orang-orang yang mencampuradukkan kebenaran dengan kebathilan, bersama mereka yang tercela aqidah dan manhajnya. Bahkan, bisa jadi dahulu ia termasuk orang yang paling keras mengkritik mereka, melontarkan sebutan “hizbiy” dan “ahlul bid’ah” kepada pihak-pihak yang kini justru ia bela. Namun karena fitnah harta, keadaan pun berbalik: orang yang dulu ia cela, kini ia rekomendasikan dan bela.

Inilah bukti nyata bagaimana fitnah harta mampu mengubah keadaan seorang penuntut ilmu: dari membela sunnah menuju membela hizbiyah; dari istiqamah di atas manhaj salaf menuju penyimpangan.

KUSIMAHA MADAXWEYNAHA JAMHUURIYADDA OO SHACABKA SOOMAALIYEED UGU HAMBALYEEYAY MUNAASABADDA 12-KA OCTOBER.

Muqdisho, Soomaaliya – 12 October 2025: Kusimaha Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda ahna Guddoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka ee Baarlamaanka Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Mudane Sheekh Aadan Maxamed Nuur (Madoobe) ayaa shacabka Soomaaliyeed ugu hambalyeeyay munaasabadda 71-aad ee Maalinta Calanka Soomaaliyeed, oo ku beegan 12-ka Oktoobar.

Guddoomiye Sheekh Aadan Madoobe ayaa xusay in maalintan ay leedahay qiime taariikhi ah oo aad u weyn, maadaama ay ina xasuusinayso maalintii ugu horreysay ee la taagay calanka buluuga ah ee Jamhuuriyadda Soomaaliya, taasoo astaan u noqotay xorriyadda, mideynta iyo jiritaanka qarannimada Soomaaliyeed.

Kusimaha Madaxweynaha Dalka Ahna Guddoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka Mudane Sheekh Aadan Maxamed Nuur (Madoobe) ayaa sheegay in calanka buluuga ah uu xambaarsan yahay taariikhda halganka dheer ee ay shacabka Soomaaliyeed u soo mareen xornimada iyo madaxbannaanida, isagoo tilmaamay in dhiig iyo dadaal badan lagu bixiyay difaaca astaamaha qaranimada, gaar ahaan calanka oo ah calaamadda ugu sarreysa ee muujisa midnimada iyo karaamada ummadda Soomaaliyeed.

Guddoomiyuhu wuxuu carrabka ku adkeeyay in waajibaad qaran ay tahay in la dhowro, la xoojiyo, lana xuso maalinta calanka, maadaama ay dhalinyarada iyo jiilka cusub barayso qiimaha waddaniyadda iyo muhiimadda lagu difaaco midnimada dalka.

“Calankeennu waa astaanta na mideysa, waa hooyga astaamaha qarannimada, waa xusuusta halgankii geesinimada lahaa ee jiilashii hore u soo galeen, sidaas darteed maanta waa maalin aan ku faanno, ku baranno, kuna xoojino midnimadeenna iyo jacaylka aan u qabno Soomaaliya”, ayuu yiri Guddoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka.

Ugu dambeyn , Kusimaha Madaxweynaha Ahna Guddoomiyaha Guddoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka ee Baarlamaanka Dalka Sheekh Aadan Madoobe ayaa ugu baaqay dhammaan shacabka Soomaaliyeed meel kasta oo ay joogaa in ay isku duubnaadaan, nabadda iyo wadajirkana ka shaqeeyaan, si loo xaqiijiyo riyooyinkii iyo himilooyinkii ay calanka u taageen halgamayaashii Soomaaliyeed ee naftooda u huray.

বাংলাদেশের ক্রিকেটার Soumya Sarkar  সম্প্রতি তাঁর শ্বশুরের মৃত্যুর পর ফেসবুকে এক আবেগঘন পোস্ট করেন। শ্বশুর ছিলেন হিন্দু সম্প্রদায়ের মানুষ, এই বিষয়টিকে কেন্দ্র করেই বাংলাদেশের এক শ্রেণির ধর্মান্ধ, অমানবিক গোষ্ঠী সামাজিক যোগাযোগমাধ্যমে বিষবাষ্প ছড়াতে শুরু করে। 

তাঁরা মন্তব্যে লিখেছেন_
➡️“নবী ও মুমিনদের জন্য উচিত নয় যে তারা mushrik (অবিশ্বাসী) ব্যক্তিদের জন্য ক্ষমা প্রার্থনা করবে, যদিও তারা আত্মীয়স্বজন হয়, যখন তাদের কাছে স্পষ্ট হয়েছে যে তারা জাহান্নামের অধিবাসী। (সূরা আত-তাওবা ৯:১১৩)”
➡️“আল্লাহ তাকে জাহান্নামের কঠিন শাস্তি দান করুক আমিন”,
➡️“দুর্ভাগ্য পোড়া কপাল, মুসলিম হয়ে মৃত্যুবরণ করতে পারেনি”,
➡️“কস্ট লাগলো! কিন্তু চিরস্থায়ী জাহান্নামের ভয়াবহ আগুনে জ্বলা ছাড়া দ্বিতীয় কোন অপশন নেই। আপনিও চিরস্থায়ী যন্ত্রনাদায়ক শাস্তিতে থাকবেন যদি ইসলাম ধর্ম গ্রহণ না করেন।”
➡️“ভাইরে, আমরা চাইলেও সে স্বর্গে যাবেনা”,
➡️“শান্তিতে ঘুমাবে হুম, আগুনের বিছানায়।”
➡️“জাহান্নাম ছাড়া স্থান নাই” [অসংখ্য মন্তব্য থেকে কিছু মন্তব্য তুলে ধরা হলো, আর-ও কিছু মন্তব্য পোষ্টের ছবিগুলোতে পাবেন।]

এরা কারা? এরা সেই তথাকথিত “ধর্মপ্রাণ মুসলমান”, যারা অন্যের মৃত্যু নিয়েও নৈতিকতা হারায় না, হারায় মানবিকতাও। আশ্চর্যের বিষয়, এই মন্তব্যগুলো করেছেন অনেকে যারা নিজেদের মসজিদের ইমাম, মাদ্রাসার শিক্ষক বা ধর্মীয় প্রচারক হিসেবে পরিচয় দেন। মানে, যারা মুসলিম সমাজে নীতি ও ধর্ম শেখানোর দায়িত্বে, তারাই ঘৃণা ছড়ানোর মূর্ত প্রতীক।

অন্যদের জান্নাত-জাহান্নাম নিয়ে যারা এভাবে মাতামাতি করে, তারা আসলে নিজেদের ভয়কে অন্যের উপর চাপিয়ে দেয়। কারণ তারা নিজেরাই নিশ্চিত নয়, তাদের ধর্ম, তাদের কাজ, তাদের মানবিকতা আদৌ ঈশ্বরের কাছে গ্রহণযোগ্য কি না। তাই তারা অন্যের জীবনের বিচার করে নিজেদের ধর্মীয় অস্পষ্টতাকে ঢেকে রাখে। এই মানসিকতা ধর্মীয় অহংকার নয়, এটি আত্মিক দুর্বলতার চরম প্রকাশ।

এদেশের একাংশ এমনভাবে বিকৃত চিন্তায় নিমজ্জিত হয়েছে যে, একজন মানুষের মৃত্যু পর্যন্ত তাদের কাছে ঘৃণার উপকরণে পরিণত হয়। যে মানুষটি কারও শ্বশুর, কারও বাবা, কারও প্রিয়জন, তার মৃত্যুতেও তারা ‘ধর্মের বিজয়’ খুঁজে বেড়ায়। এ কেমন শিক্ষা? এ কেমন ধর্ম? যদি মসজিদের ইমাম ও মাদ্রাসার শিক্ষকগণই এমন অন্ধ বিদ্বেষ ছড়ান, তাহলে তাঁদের কাছে ধর্মশিক্ষা নেওয়া ছাত্রছাত্রীদের ভবিষ্যৎ কেমন হবে, তা অনায়াসেই অনুমেয়।
